skill_name: Explain the five forces model of industry competition
workflow: The Five Forces Model of Industry Competition was developed by Michael Porter and suggests that there are five forces that affect the profitability and attractiveness of any given industry. These forces are suppliers, buyers, competitive rivalry, threats of substitutions and new entrants. Suppliers and buyers have the power to influence prices and the availability of resources to a company.
